caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a sofa with a solid wooden frame and plush, upholstered surfaces. The wood appears to be a dark brown color with visible wood grain and is used for the frame, armrests, and legs of the sofa. The upholstered areas, including the seat, backrest, and arms, are covered in a rich teal or turquoise fabric. The sofa has a high, slightly curved back, rounded scroll arms, and ornate legs ending in small casters. On the left side of the drawing, there is an inset showing a close-up profile view of the arm’s scroll detail, marked with dimensions "2'' = 1'." On the right side, another inset displays a side elevation of the sofa, highlighting its structural details and measurements, also marked "2'' = 1'." The overall composition is symmetrical, with the sofa centered and the two inset diagrams on either side. The artist's signature, "M. Malbeck," is located in the bottom right corner. The background is plain and uncolored, focusing all attention on the sofa and its construction details.
title: Settee
